g.title: F3_COMP
g.text: Age/DOB, HPV validity/result, sample type, event stage, immune status where relevant

g.title: F3_CSTOP
g.text: Missing critical Figure 3 facts -> request information

g.title: F3_U25STOP
g.text: If already in follow-up, use next indicated appointment

g.title: F3_INV
g.text: Repeat HPV as soon as practicable

g.title: F3_SWAB1618
g.text: If swab: obtain LBC/cytology at colposcopy

g.title: F3_RET_LBC
g.text: Return for clinical examination and clinician-taken LBC

g.title: F3_R1
g.text: First repeat HPV + cytology in 12 months

g.title: F3_R1OV
g.text: At every repeat: apply invalid/unsuitable, unsatisfactory-cytology,

g.title: F3_R1NEG
g.text: Return 5 years if immune competent / 3 years if verified immune deficient

g.title: F3_R2NEG
g.text: Return 5 years if immune competent / 3 years if verified immune deficient

g.title: IMM_PROV
g.text: Record classifier, evidence, date, rationale, specialist input
and whether immune status was sent on laboratory request

g.title: IMM_NO
g.text: Not immune deficient on this fact alone
Use ordinary interval unless another indication
